description: Raindrop connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's saved Raindrop.io bookmarks as `raindrop:bookmark` items in the local index — the bookmarked URL, title, the excerpt/description, the user's note, the domain, the item type (link/article/image/video/document/audio), tags, and the parent collection id — plus the collections themselves as `raindrop:collection` items (title, raindrop count, public flag, view, color, sort, parent id), so a bookmark's `collectionId` resolves to a real indexed record. Useful for answering bookmarking questions ("what did I save about retries?", "which shelf is that bookmark on?") without leaving Nimbus. Bearer API-token auth (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` — a Raindrop.io test token or OAuth access token; never logged). The SaaS host (api.raindrop.io) is fixed. Raindrop paginates the `/rest/v1/raindrops/0` endpoint by page number (0-based, page_size=50), returning the `{ result, items, count }` envelope; collections come from the two UNPAGINATED endpoints `/rest/v1/collections` (root) and `/rest/v1/collections/childrens` (nested). `created` / `lastUpdate` are ISO-8601 (converted to epoch-ms on index). Collection `external_id`s are namespaced `collection/<id>` because Raindrop numbers collections and raindrops in separate id spaces. Highlights and per-collection filtering of bookmarks remain deferred follow-ups.
author: Nimbus
